notes.title: November 1, 2024 Update Content
notes.notes:
Dear players, hello! On November 1, 2024, we brought you a brand new version 14 update. This update mainly focuses on two aspects: problem fixing and function adjustment, aiming to provide you with a better and more convenient user experience.

Problem Fix
We are well aware that some minor problems may cause trouble to everyone, so in this update, we focused on solving the following problems:
- Fix the problem that switching desktop wallpaper will cause program errors
- Fix the problem that all components cannot be displayed when switching desktop zoom ratio.
- Fix the problem that the reset position of components cannot be centered after switching desktop zoom ratio.

Function Adjustment
In order to make Ai Vpet more intelligent and practical, we have optimized and adjusted some functions:
- Optimize the AI ​​generation logic, and the character generation Japanese and English are more accurate
- The character can summarize the results of the network search and broadcast it, instead of opening the web page for the user to view it by himself

We have been committed to creating a better Ai Vpet for everyone, and hope that this update will make you more satisfied. If you have any questions or suggestions during use, please feel free to contact us. Thank you for your continued support and love for Ai Vpet!

notes.title: August 18th Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone~~Another week has passed, and after enduring the torment of two planners and staying up all night for three nights, we have finally expanded our computing power by four times. Although we sacrificed five graphics cards and six programmers, we still announced the following eight important updates before 7 o'clock:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073139/b324533b9fa0e3c7394cac06e11d09f4c863676d.png[/img]

1. The voice is no longer difficult to pronounce, the Japanese and English pronunciation of the 9 voices have been optimized (solve the accent problem of local people speaking foreign languages)

2. Character archiving is optimized, each model character can be archived separately, and the model’s work description can be used as the character (solve the problem of models sharing the same soul and the author being unable to share the soul)

3. The character design capacity has been expanded to 1,000 words (solving the problem that the character cannot be more specific and detailed)

4. Keyword wake-up optimization, the optimization removes nicknames, and now the character name can be used to wake up voice interaction (solve the problem that the software sometimes pretends not to hear human words and acts like the old 6)

5. Added the function of recognizing music, playing dance, and then continuing to play music for 5 seconds (solved the problem of software not understanding music players)

6. Dialogue input is expanded 4 times (solve the problem of not being able to talk too much)

7. Intelligent semantic recognition, as long as the meaning of opening, web search, and hiding is expressed in the semantics, the corresponding operations can be performed without using three fixed keywords (solving the problem of having to use secret codes to communicate)

8. Live2d can recognize expressions when uploading, and will automatically convert expression files into action files for use (solving the problem of live2d models with only expressions being homeless)

[h3]Special thanks:[/h3]
Finally, we would like to express our special thanks to each of the following users for their help, support, and thoughtful suggestions:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073139/71e63fcb54e7a25419a4852930c26a037ad5a1e9.png[/img]

The test server is about to start testing the pendant mode.. Interested friends can join the group and enter the test server to experience it first.

In addition, we are grateful for the active feedback after the launch, which has helped us further improve the software functions and troubleshoot system issues. Special thanks to the following players for their cooperation:

2. Fixed the problem of white screen in the settings interface for some computers.
3. Fixed the issue where switching models when the download of some models was incomplete would result in an empty model. Now, when the download is incomplete, it will prompt that the model has not been downloaded and will not switch the model.
4. Currently, the issue of unrecognizable wake-up dialogue after losing focus has been temporarily blocked, and a key-press speaking function has been added. You can customize the key combination in the settings interface. The default key combination is ALT + X.

notes.title: July 26 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
[h2]his week's updates are as follows:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073139/6bbb5965a2313abe96f96a65da4f3454a7d6895d.gif[/img]

1.Command Activation: You can now use the keyword "open" to open any file or folder on your desktop (including contents within folders), as well as launch any installed program.
a) Example: Typing "open NetEase Cloud" will open NetEase Cloud Music.

2.Command Search: You can now use the keyword "web search" to quickly search for any content online.
a) Example: Using “command search” to search Crayon Shin-chan" will open the default browser and search for Crayon Shin-chan.

3.Appear/Hide: You can now use the keyword "hide" or the right-click menu to hide, or drag characters to the edge of the screen to hide them. Characters can be unhidden by right-clicking or dragging them back.

4.Upload Preview: When uploading models, you can now preview their actions and configure movements more conveniently.

5.Layout Mode: When configuring settings, you can adjust the size and position of models, overall layout size, bubble and input box positions. You can also adjust where the model's probe extends in hide mode, allowing for more customized desktop pet layouts.

6.New Voices: We've added 5 new voice options in this update, enriching our voice library.

7.Mouse pointer: When the mouse is over the character model, the mouse pointer will switch to the exclusive cat paw skin.
